title: 第18章 空间安家-《70年代开局，我靠零元购发家》
content:
第(1/3)页

    干活干活，开心地干活。

    王建新站在空间里，看着堆积如山的物资，搓了搓手。东西多了也是烦恼，乱七八糟地堆着，找个东西都得翻半天。得好好归置归置，分门别类放好。

    但看着这堆成山的物资，他又有点惆怅。

    “为啥自己的空间不是那种平平的地，所有的东西一个意念就可以一直往上码，上边的空间也都能利用上？”王建新叹了口气。

    人家的空间，一个念头东西就自动归位，整整齐齐码到天上去。他这空间倒好，搬东西还得自己动手，跟搬砖似的。

    哎，没办法，命苦。

    先从火车开始整理吧。

    王建新走到那列火车跟前，围着转了一圈。火车静静地停在空间边缘，车头朝东，车厢一节连一节，黑绿色的漆面在空间的光线下泛着暗光。

    “这回把卧室搬在火车上，这不是又有睡觉的地方，又有做饭的地方吗？”王建新越想越觉得这个主意好。

    火车地方大，车厢多，住着比露天搭床强多了。而且火车有窗户，有门，拉上窗帘就是个独立的小世界。

    第一步，先从火车上改造。

    王建新爬上火车，一节一节地看过去。行李车在最末尾，空间最大，但没窗户，适合当仓库。然后是硬卧车厢，三节，有窗户有包厢，适合住人。接着是软卧车厢，两节，比硬卧宽敞，铺位更舒服。再往前是餐车，有厨房有餐厅。最前面是两节高级软卧，带洗脸间的那种。

    他在脑子里规划了一下。

    一节高级软卧改造成自己的大卧室和客厅。那车厢本来就有两个包厢，每个包厢两人铺。把中间的隔墙打通，就是一个大房间。包厢里本来就有洗脸间，方便得很。

    再改造一节高级软卧，把它弄成书房。另一节放书架、办公桌，以后写信、记账、研究地图，都有地方。

    餐车就做厨房和餐厅。厨房里本来就有灶具，虽然不太合用，但改改就能用。餐厅那些桌子椅子，正好吃饭用，多余的拆除掉。

    剩下的车厢全部当做物资储备库房。一节放零食，一节放日用百货，剩下的放米面粮油。放不下的，把它全放在火车顶上——火车顶是平的，绑一绑就能放东西。

    还得注意分门别类，把容易过期的、放不住的放在最明显的地方，先紧这些吃。能放住的就不着急了，往后搁。

    规划好了，王建新开始动手。

    但动手之前，他得先搞清楚空间里到底都有啥物资。东西太多，好些收了以后都没仔细看过，得先盘盘家底。

    王建新走到物资区，找了个本子和笔，开始记录。

    米面粮油。面粉有几百袋，从哈登堡勒格收的、从赛音山达收的、从乌兰巴托收的，加在一起得有好几百袋。大米也不少，赛音山达那几袋加上乌兰巴托收的，够吃好几年的。油更不用说了，食用油、柴油、汽油，桶装的大大小小上百桶。糖有白糖红糖，好几十大袋。

    零食区。奶糖、水果糖、巧克力、饼干、面包、月饼、糕点，种类多得记不过来。还有各种罐头，肉罐头、鱼罐头、水果罐头，摞起来比人还高。

    日用百货。香皂、肥皂、洗发水、牙膏、牙刷、毛巾、卫生纸，堆了好几堆。衣服鞋帽更不用说了，蒙古袍、棉衣、单衣、布鞋、毡靴、皮靴，成箱成箱的。锅碗瓢勺、搪瓷盆、暖水瓶、煤油灯，应有尽有。

    王建新一边记录一边记住位置，忙活了半天时间，终于记了个差不多。

    记完了，他出了空间。

    站在土坯房里，他意念一动，试着操控空间里的物资。他想把米面粮油先挪到行李车厢里。

    心念一动——空间里那堆米面粮油凭空消失了，下一秒，出现在了行李车厢里，整整齐齐地码着。

    “嘿！”王建新乐了。

    这个办法好。在外面用意念操控，比在空间里搬东西省事多了。在空间里搬东西，得自己动手，一袋一袋地扛。在外面一个念头就完事了。

    “要是在空间里也能这样，心念一动便能完成，那简直就是神了。”王建新试了试在空间里用意念搬东西——不行，在空间里，他只能用意念收放东西，不能用意念移动。收进来的东西落在哪儿就是哪儿，想挪地方得自己动手，除非收的时候直接想好位置，便会出现在自己指定位置。

    “也不知道为什么，难道这就是秘境？”

    不管了，方法可行就行。以后整理物资，就站在空间外面用意念操控，省时省力。

    王建新回到空间里，开始动手改造火车。

    他先从工具区找了一堆工具——扳手、螺丝刀、锤子、撬棍、钢锯，能拿的全拿上。

    爬上火车，先从硬卧车厢开始拆。

    硬卧车厢里，铺位是上中下三层的，铁架子是螺栓固定的，得用扳手拧。王建新炼气二层的手劲大，拧螺丝跟拧瓶盖似的，三下五除二就卸下来一个。铺位拆了，包厢隔板也拆了，车厢里变得空空荡荡的。

    拆下来的东西，他分门别类地收好。铁架子摞在一起，木板码整齐，被褥叠好放一边。万一以后能用上呢？勤俭持家是咱们的美德。

    普通软卧车厢也拆，比硬卧好拆，东西少。铺位拆了，隔板拆了，车厢腾空了。

    餐车不用怎么改，本来就有厨房和餐厅，收拾收拾就能用。

    高级软卧车厢是重点。王建新把两节高级软卧中间的隔墙打通——这费了点工夫，墙是钢板加木板的，得先拆木板再割钢板。好在空间里有电焊机，他接上发电机的电，用切割机把钢板割开，两面墙打通，成了一间大屋子。

    打通以后，空间大多了。一边放个大床，一边放沙发茶几，卧室兼客厅。

    他从物资里挑了一张大床，实木的，雕花的，从乌兰巴托百货大楼收来的高档货。床垫是弹簧的，铺上被褥，躺上去软乎乎的。床头柜一边一个，上面放台钟。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Work, work, work happily.

Wang Jianxin stood in the space, looked at the mountains of supplies, and rubbed his hands.It’s also annoying to have too many things. They are piled up in a mess, and it takes a long time to dig through them to find anything.It must be properly organized and put away in categories.

But looking at the mountains of supplies, he felt a little melancholy.

"Why isn't my space a flat surface, where everything can be moved upwards with just one thought, and the space above can be used?" Wang Jianxin sighed.

In other people’s spaces, everything will automatically return to its place as soon as you think about it, and it will be neatly stacked up to the sky.The space he has is good, but he has to move things by himself, just like moving bricks.

“Hey, there is no way, life is miserable.

Let’s start with the train.

Wang Jianxin walked to the train and walked around it.The train stopped quietly at the edge of the space, with the front facing east, and the carriages were connected one after another. The black-green paint surface glowed darkly in the light of the space.

“This time, if we move the bedroom on the train, wouldn’t it give us a place to sleep and a place to cook?” The more Wang Jianxin thought about it, the more he thought it was a good idea.

The train has a large space and many carriages, so living there is much better than setting up a bed in the open air.Moreover, the train has windows and doors, and when you close the curtains, you are a small independent world.

The first step is to transform the train.

Wang Jianxin climbed onto the train and looked at it section by section.The luggage cart is at the end and has the largest space, but it has no windows, so it is suitable for use as a warehouse.Then there are three hard-sleeper carriages, with windows and private rooms, suitable for people to live in.Next is the soft sleeper carriage, which has two compartments. It is wider than the hard sleeper carriage and has more comfortable berths.Further ahead is the dining car, with a kitchen and a dining room.At the front are two sections of high-end soft sleepers, the kind with a washroom.

He planned it in his mind.

One section of the premium soft sleeper has been transformed into its own large bedroom and living room.The carriage originally had two private rooms, each with two berths.Open the middle partition wall and you will have a large room.There is a washroom in the private room, which is very convenient.

Renovate a section of the high-end soft sleeper and turn it into a study room.The other section is for bookshelves and desks. There will be room for writing letters, keeping accounts, and studying maps in the future.

The dining car serves as the kitchen and dining room.There is already a stove in the kitchen. Although it is not suitable for use, it can be used after being modified.The tables and chairs in the restaurant are just for eating, so any excess should be removed.

The remaining carriages are all used as material storage warehouses.One section is for snacks, one section is for daily necessities, and the rest is for rice, flour, grains and oils.If it doesn't fit, put it all on the roof of the train - the roof of the train is flat and can be tied up to hold things.

You should also pay attention to sorting the items into categories, putting items that are easy to expire and cannot be stored in the most obvious place, and eat these first.Don't worry if you can put it down, just put it back.

With the planning completed, Wang Jianxin started to take action.

But before taking action, he had to first figure out what materials were in the space.There are so many things that I haven’t even looked at them carefully after collecting them. I have to take stock of my family first.

Wang Jianxin walked to the supplies area, found a notebook and pen, and started recording.

Rice, flour, grains and oils.There are hundreds of bags of flour, collected from Hardenberg Leg, Seinshanda, and Ulaanbaatar. Together, there are hundreds of bags.There is also a lot of rice. The few bags of Saiyinsanda and the ones collected by Ulaanbaatar are enough to last for several years.Not to mention oil, cooking oil, diesel, gasoline, there are hundreds of barrels of various sizes.There are dozens of large bags of sugar, including white sugar and brown sugar.

Snack area.There are so many kinds of milk candies, fruit candies, chocolates, biscuits, breads, moon cakes, and pastries that I can’t even remember them all.There are also various cans, including canned meat, canned fish, and canned fruits. The stacks are taller than a person.

Daily necessities.There were piles of soap, soap, shampoo, toothpaste, toothbrushes, towels, and toilet paper.Not to mention clothes, shoes and hats, Mongolian robes, cotton-padded clothes, single clothes, cloth shoes, felt boots, leather boots, all in boxes.Pots, pans, enamel basins, thermos bottles, kerosene lamps, everything.

Wang Jianxin recorded and remembered the location at the same time. After working for a long time, he finally remembered almost everything.

After recording, he left the space.

Standing in the adobe house, he tried to control the materials in the space with a thought.He wanted to move the rice, flour, grain and oil into the luggage compartment first.

With a thought in my mind - the pile of rice, flour, grain and oil in the space disappeared out of thin air, and the next second, it appeared in the luggage compartment, neatly stacked.

"Hey!" Wang Jianxin was happy.

This method is good.It is much easier to control things with your thoughts outside than to move things in space.When moving things in the space, you have to do it yourself, carrying bag after bag.One thought outside and that's it.

"If it could be like this in space, and it could be done with just a thought, that would be amazing." Wang Jianxin tried moving things in space with his mind - but it didn't work. In space, he could only use his mind to store things, not move them.The things you put in will be wherever you put them. If you want to move them, you have to do it yourself. Unless you directly think of the location when you put them away, they will appear in your designated place.

“I don’t know why, is this the secret realm?”

No matter what, as long as the method works.In the future, when organizing supplies, just stand outside the space and control them with your thoughts, saving time and effort.

Wang Jianxin returned to the space and began to transform the train.

He first found a bunch of tools from the tool area - wrenches, screwdrivers, hammers, crowbars, hacksaws, everything he could get.

Climb on the train and start dismantling the hard sleeper compartment first.

In the hard-sleeper carriage, the bunks are on three levels: upper, middle and lower. The iron frame is fixed with bolts and needs to be tightened with a wrench.Wang Jianxin's hands on the second level of Qi Refining are so strong that he can twist a screw like a bottle cap. He can remove one in three strokes, five divided by two.The bunks were removed, the compartment partitions were also removed, and the carriage became empty.

He put away the dismantled things in categories.The iron shelves are stacked together, the wooden boards are arranged neatly, and the quilts are folded and put aside.What if it can be used in the future?Being diligent and thrifty is our virtue.

Ordinary soft sleeper compartments can also be dismantled. They are easier to dismantle than hard sleeper compartments and have less stuff.The bunks were torn down, the partitions were torn down, and the carriages were emptied.

The dining car does not need to be modified much. It already has a kitchen and dining room, so you can use it after tidying up.

The focus is on the premium soft sleeper compartment.Wang Jianxin opened up the partition wall between the two sections of high-end soft sleepers - this took some time. The wall was made of steel plates and wooden boards. The wooden boards had to be removed first and then the steel plates were cut.Fortunately, there was a welding machine in the space. He connected the electricity from the generator and used a cutting machine to cut the steel plate. The two walls were opened to create a large room.

After opening up, there will be more space.With a large bed on one side and a sofa and coffee table on the other, the bedroom doubles as the living room.

He picked a large bed from the supplies, made of solid wood, carved, high-end goods collected from the Ulaanbaatar Department Store.The mattress is spring-based, and it's soft when you lay down on it.There is one bedside table on either side, with a desk clock on it.
